Lat/Long: 41.758047, -75.795457 (Approximated from CITY_STATE)
Report Description
CALLER STATED THERE WAS AN EXPLOSION AT NATURAL GAS COMPRESSOR STATION. THE LOCAL NEWS REPORTED A FIRE BROKE OUT AT A NATURAL GAS COMPRESSOR STATION LATE TUESDAY IN BROOKLYN TOWNSHIP. THE COMPRESSOR STATION IS IN THE 100 BLOCK OF TURNPIKE ROAD IN BROOKLYN TOWNSHIP, NEAR MONTROSE, CAUGHT FIRE SHORTLY AFTER 11 P.M. TUESDAY. ELEVEN EMPLOYEES WERE ON SITE WHEN THE FIRE OCCURRED IN ONE OF THE STATION'S COMPRESSORS. ALL OF THE EMPLOYEES WERE ABLE TO EVACUATE SAFELY AND THERE WERE NO INJURIES. CREWS FROM MONTROSE, HOP BOTTOM, CLIFFORD AND HARFORD WERE CALLED TO THE SCENE SHORTLY BEFORE 11:10 P.M. TUESDAY.
